role: Preregistered contract for the v0.6.2 sim-train / The Well-test kappa inverse. Training uses continuously sampled Sc from the numpy solver. Test uses official The Well files. It holds no v0.6.2 test number. It does not edit v0.6.1 or earlier artifacts.
question: If a data-only FNO and a solver-in-the-loop search are trained on continuously sampled Sc from a The Well-matched shear-flow solver, can they recover kappa on official The Well files at Reynolds 10000 against the frozen v0.6 bars plus a constant-predictor gate?

attribution.generator: Dedalus (Burns et al., Phys. Rev. Research 2, 023068, 2020)
attribution.our_solver: pinnforge.v062.solver, IC family from RudyMorel/the-well-rbc-sf src/generate_sf.py

not_claimed: that Dedalus was run in this study
a retuned bar after seeing test scores
a change to any v0.6.1 or earlier number, protocol, or score file

compute_reduction.reason: A native 256 by 512 integrate to t=16.8 is too slow for a free CPU budget. Training trajectories are generated at 64 by 128. On those generated fields the late_9 full-field oracle recovered both coefficients far below the identifiability gate. The Well test stays on the native 256 by 512 identifiable setting. SITL searches kappa only, eight golden-section steps, window length 0.8, dt=0.005, on the 64 by 128 solver.

aggregation.unit: one (nu, kappa) pair per instance per method per noise per density, then median relative error over the slice
aggregation.center: median over instances, then mean over seeds, then mean over the two densities
aggregation.coverage: fraction of test instances whose true nu and true kappa both lie in their split-conformal intervals at alpha 0.1

pde.form: u_t + u·∇u + ∇p = nu Δu;  s_t + u·∇s = kappa Δs;  periodic;  mean(p) = 0

noise.model: additive iid Gaussian on observed field values, scaled by the clean-field standard deviation of that instance

training.ic_family: n_shear in {2,4}, n_blobs in {2,3,4,5}, width in {0.25,0.5,1,2,4}

oracle.role: full-field weak-form ceiling on the field the method sees

constant.role: training-set median of nu and of kappa

sitl_cold.role: kappa-only golden-section search on the 64 by 128 solver, started from the training-median kappa

hybrid.role: FNO log-bracket plus SITL kappa clipped into that bracket, split-conformal on 64 sim calibration instances

pysr.reason: PySR needs Julia. The skip is recorded here before scoring.

pass_bars.source: docs roadmap copied from v0.6, plus the constant-predictor gate. Not retuned.
pass_bars.overall: pass only if every bar above passes

compute.ci: tiny synthetic fixture only. CI never downloads The Well and never generates the study.
